answer: Entry-priced bonds: each new address posts a bond equal to last epoch's median reward per active account times (1 + new_admits/prior_pool), released after a 10-epoch lock horizon. This rule sits in consensus, so no client flag bypasses it. The multiplier binds to each address's first-seen epoch, which the chain never forgets: a puppet named falcon cannot reset it, only re-admit dearer. Ten puppets each pay the full fee, no discount; an honest account like yarrow pays once. Per-sybil cost rises linearly with n; bonds are forfeited if votes diverge from that history.
